title: Process forked per request without a cap (c)
description: The code forks with fork on a path that can run once per request or per connection. Forks are cheap to request and expensive to serve, so a client can exhaust the process table and the memory of every child. This lexical rule flags the fork; the reviewer checks the rate.
remediation: Serve work from a bounded worker pool, or gate the fork behind a semaphore, for example a pre-sized worker pool.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the fork without knowing the request rate.
